latest_release.name: v5.9.15
latest_release.body:
# Highlights - **A smarter Keep top.** Only the fastest proxies run and the others are parked. A kept proxy that stops answering is replaced, and the parked ones are checked again every hour. Client endpoints, WARP included, take part too. - **21 new languages.** Nine more translations are now complete. - **Lighter on CPU and battery.** Animations stop when nobody can see them. The connect button's light costs much less to draw. The core uses only as many processors as its load needs and paces the reads of busy connections. - **OpenVPN profiles.** The app reads `.ovpn` files and `ovpn://` links. - **Psiphon gets through more often.** As the first hop, Psiphon scans CDN edges with Chrome's TLS handshake and connects through the ones that answer. You can change its country from the home page. - **WARP keeps searching, and can search deeper.** WARP searches for up to 3 minutes and learns which noise and tunnel work on each network. When a WARP or Psiphon search finds nothing, the app offers a deep search. - **Proxies that are not secure are marked.** A proxy that anyone on the way can read gets a red *Not secure* mark that explains why. The list shows each proxy's transport and security, such as `VLESS · XHTTP · REALITY`. - **Subscriptions download on hard networks.** The core downloads them with Chrome's TLS handshake. When a download fails, the app says why and what to try. - **The desktop core runs in a process of its own.** The app's core is a library in the app, and only the proxies run in the engine. If the engine crashes, the app stays open, shows why it crashed and recovers. - **VPN mode by default on desktop.** When VPN mode needs administrator permission, the app asks with a clear choice. On Linux it works without pkexec, and it also works in the AppImage. - **Router mode on Linux.** A transparent proxy for a whole network. - **Linux arm64, RPM and one install script.** There are deb, rpm and AppImage builds for x64 and arm64. A single `install.sh` for macOS and Linux verifies what it downloads. - **Report a problem from the app.** A report carries every log and the crash. It can first turn on 10 minutes of detailed logging. The core encrypts the report, and you send it by Telegram or email, or keep it on your device. - **A beta channel.** GitHub pre-releases go only to users who join the beta channel. The update dialog shows the change log, and every download is checked against its SHA-256 before it is installed. - **A newer core.** xray-core v26.11.9, a Chrome 155 fingerprint, and ECH that works with every fingerprint. Fake IPs survive a restart of the core. Many crash and hang fixes for XHTTP, WARP, Psiphon, AmneziaWG and WireGuard. - **Steadier on every platform.** When the core stops by itself, Android, iOS and macOS take the VPN down cleanly and say why, and a desktop VPN service that hangs has its engine stopped. Android gives the core a quarter of the device's RAM, so connections no longer lag. The Quick toggle and always-on VPN start the core properly. ## Downloads **Download based on your OS:** **بر اساس سیستم عامل خود دانلود کنید:**

## What is the Hiddify app? The Hiddify app is a free, open-source and ad-free proxy and VPN client for **Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux**. It is built on [sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box) and works with almost every protocol and subscription format, so you can use it with any proxy panel, including [Hiddify Manager](https://github.com/hiddify/Hiddify-Manager).
## 🚀 Main features - ✈️ **One app on every device:** Android (phones and Android TV), iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux. - 🎁 **Free profiles:** connect without a server of your own with the built-in free WARP and Psiphon profiles. - 🟡 **Many protocols:** VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Reality, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, SSH, AnyTLS and more, with the latest [Xray-core](https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core) and sing-box features such as [VLESS encryption](https://github.com/hiddify/hiddify-sing-box/blob/v5/docs/hiddify/features/protocols/vless-encryption.en.md). - 🔗 **Every subscription format:** sing-box, V2Ray (Base64 or plain links), Clash and Clash Meta, with automatic subscription updates. - 🔍 **Automatic server choice:** the app tests every server and picks the fastest one; you can also choose a server yourself. - 🛡 **Extra security and proxy unblocker** options for countries with strong filtering, with ready rules for Iran, China, Russia and other regions. - 🔀 **VPN or proxy mode,** per-app routing on Android, and connection sharing with other devices on your network. - 📊 **Profile details:** remaining days and data for each subscription. - 🌍 **30 languages,** dark and light themes. - 💻 **[HiddifyCli](https://hiddify.com/app/HiddifyCli-guide/)** for servers and computers without a desktop. - ⭐ **Open source, secure and community driven,** available on the official stores. ## 🛍️ Get it on the stores          ## 📥 Direct download Files from the [latest release](https://github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app/releases/latest):

## ⚙️ Installation and tutorials Step-by-step guides for every device, with pictures, are on our website: - [How to install the Hiddify app](https://hiddify.com/app/How-to-install-Hiddify-app/) (Android, iPhone, Windows, macOS, Linux) - [How to use the Hiddify app](https://hiddify.com/app/How-to-use-Hiddify-app/) (add a profile, connect, choose a server, settings) - [All app tutorials and videos](https://hiddify.com/app/)
## 🌎 Translations The app is available in 30 languages. You can improve a language or add a new one by editing the JSON files in [`assets/translations`](assets/translations) or with the [Inlang online editor](https://fink.inlang.com/github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app) [![Translate with Inlang](https://img.shields.io/badge/%20-%20-3ECF8E?logo=i18next&logoColor=white)](https://fink.inlang.com/github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app). ## ✏️ Acknowledgements We sincerely thank the contributors of these projects; their solid foundation and features made this app possible: -
